requirements.title: Fortran statements are executable or nonexecutable
requirements.definition: Each Fortran statement is classified as either executable or nonexecutable.

pending.executable-statement-class: Use assignment x=84 as an executable statement after declarations; main checks x==84.
pending.nonexecutable-statement-class: Use IMPLICIT NONE and integer :: x before the first executable statement; source-control verifies they configure the later assignment rather than execute actions.
